name: First National Exhibition of Concrete Art
name_zh: 第一届全国具体艺术展
date_text: December 1956, São Paulo; January 1957, Rio de Janeiro
location: São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
description: Bois recounts the two-city exhibition as an attempted federation of concrete artists that instead deepened the split between São Paulo and Rio networks.

sources.author: Yve-Alain Bois
sources.chapter: 1959e: The Manifesto of Neoconcrete Art is published
